title: Local C^{1,alpha} bounds on small balls imply IsLocallyHolderCkα 1 alpha
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, alpha > 0, U an open subset of R^n and f : R^n -> R^l. Suppose every x in U has r > 0 and a real C such that f is C^1 on the open ball B_r(x) and ||Df(y) - Df(z)|| <= C ||y - z||^alpha for all y, z in B_r(x). Then IsLocallyHolderCkα 1 alpha f U holds: f is C^1 on U, and for every compact K contained in U there is C' with ||iteratedFDeriv R 1 f x - iteratedFDeriv R 1 f y|| <= C' ||x - y||^alpha for all x, y in K.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (U : Set (Rn n)), 0 < α → IsOpen U → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball x r) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x r, ∀ z ∈ ball x r, ‖fderiv ℝ f y - fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α) → IsLocallyHolderCkα 1 α f U
